turns.speaker: layla
turns.text: Hello, this is Layla from Downtown Dentist. How may I help you today?

turns.speaker: robert
turns.text: Hi Layla! I've been having tooth problems — I think I have a cavity and one tooth has been aching for a couple of days. Can you guys help me with that?

turns.speaker: layla
turns.text: Oh no, I'm so sorry — toothaches are the worst. But don't worry, we've got you covered.

turns.speaker: layla
turns.text: Let's get you seen as soon as possible so we can figure out what's going on. First, could I start with your full name?

turns.speaker: layla
turns.text: Thanks, Robert! Now, what's the best email address for you?

turns.speaker: robert
turns.text: Um, that's robertjohn123 — at yahoo dot com.

turns.speaker: layla
turns.text: Got it — let me read that back to make sure I've got it right: robertjohn123 at yahoo dot com. Is that correct?

turns.speaker: layla
turns.text: Awesome, thank you so much! Give me one second to get you set up… You're all set, Robert!

turns.speaker: layla
turns.text: You mentioned a toothache and a possible cavity — let's get you in for an emergency appointment. When works best? We open as early as 7:30 AM today.

turns.speaker: robert
turns.text: Um, I'd like to come tomorrow — and one more thing: please check everything else while I'm there.

turns.speaker: layla
turns.text: Alright, Robert — a full checkup plus the toothache. Let me check tomorrow's availability… I see openings at 8:00 AM, 11:30 AM, and 2:00 PM. Do any of those work for you?

turns.speaker: layla
turns.text: Perfect! You're booked with Dr. Pegel tomorrow at 8 AM — one hour. You're all booked in, Robert: a confirmation text and email are on the way, plus a reminder before your visit. Take care!

outcome.appointment: Dr. Pegel · tomorrow 8:00 AM · 1 hour (full checkup + toothache)
